leaks.line: Okay, noted on the cleaning supplies. What about customer service? If he is nervous talking to angry parents during the rush, what should he say? I want him to have a script so he does not freeze up.

leaks.line: I understand that rates vary, but absolutely do not suggest I use a credit union because I have had terrible experiences with their customer service software. I prefer a traditional bank. Can you explain why my tenure matters less than I thought?

It is wise to start him at the register or with prep work. These roles allow you to observe his customer service skills and attention to detail under lower pressure. Once he demonstrates reliability there, you can gradually introduce him to the cooking line.
